summary: Get-by-id commands no longer pin spec sample ids in pp:happy-args.
reason: Spec sample ids in pp:happy-args are authoritative for the live runner, so every account got 404 even when a real resource existed. Without them the runner resolves an id from the list companion or records a fixture skip when the account has none.
validated_outcome: hosts get-by-id resolves a real host id in the live matrix.
